$comment: The offer catalogue: what this pipeline can sell, grouped by line. WF-04 and WF-05 read it at run time; the agent schemas, the leads constraint and the prompts must agree with it, and infra/scripts/check-offers.py (make validate) fails when they do not. Adding an offer means editing this file, a migration for leads.recommended_offer, the enums it names, and the prompts' offer tables. Prices are what prompts/conversation.md may quote, and check-offers.py fails when a prompt's offer table states a different one. price_eur, credit_window_days and founding are the Process Automation Audit's published terms (the process-audit page at lines.automation.url, https://example.com/process-audit/). Taglines and URLs are placeholders: replace Your Company and example.com with your own business before sending anything. campaigns.offer (0026) must name one of these codes.
